EquipmentLibrary.Description: XCGF standard library: kinematic definitions. Fixed-wing data follow the aircraft performance data of Command: Modern Operations (CMO), so that a CMO importer maps them one to one (see docs/cmo-mapping.md).

KinematicDefinition.name: Kinematic
KinematicDefinition.Description: Root kinematic. Every kinematic derives from it and inherits its position and orientation.

Parameter.name: Position
Parameter.Description: Position of the entity when it is created.

Parameter.name: Orientation
Parameter.Description: Heading, pitch and roll of the entity when it is created.

KinematicDefinition.name: FixedWingKinematic
KinematicDefinition.Description: Fixed-wing aircraft kinematic. Speeds and fuel consumption come from a performance table (altitude band x throttle setting), as in CMO; the other data bound or complete it.

Parameter.name: EmptyMass
Parameter.Description: Mass of the aircraft without fuel nor payload.

Parameter.name: MaxTakeoffMass
Parameter.Description: Highest mass at which the aircraft can take off, fuel and payload included.

Parameter.name: EngineType
Parameter.Description: Kind of engines propelling the aircraft.

Parameter.name: EngineCount
Parameter.Description: Number of engines.

Parameter.name: DryThrust
Parameter.Description: Thrust of one engine at maximum dry power (Full throttle).

Parameter.name: AfterburnerThrust
Parameter.Description: Thrust of one engine with afterburner (Flank throttle); equal to the dry thrust without afterburner.

Parameter.name: FuelType
Parameter.Description: Fuel burnt by the engines.

Parameter.name: FuelCapacity
Parameter.Description: Internal fuel capacity. External tanks are separate equipments.

Parameter.name: PerformanceTable
Parameter.Description: Speed and fuel consumption for each altitude band and throttle setting. The kinematic interpolates between bands.

Parameter.name: StallSpeed
Parameter.Description: Lowest speed at which the aircraft keeps flying. The kinematic never flies slower.

Parameter.name: MaxSpeed
Parameter.Description: Highest speed the aircraft can reach. The kinematic never flies faster.

Parameter.name: ClimbRate
Parameter.Description: Highest vertical speed in climb.

Parameter.name: Ceiling
Parameter.Description: Highest altitude the aircraft can reach. Movement orders above it are capped.

Parameter.name: Agility
Parameter.Description: Manoeuvrability rating, as in CMO: the higher, the better the aircraft turns and evades.

Parameter.name: MinRunwayLength
Parameter.Description: Shortest runway the aircraft can take off from and land on.

Parameter.name: InitialSpeed
Parameter.Description: Speed of the aircraft when it is created, bounded by the stall speed and the maximum speed.

Parameter.name: InitialThrottle
Parameter.Description: Throttle setting when the aircraft is created.

Parameter.name: InitialFuel
Parameter.Description: Fuel on board when the aircraft is created, bounded by the fuel capacity.

TaskRef.Description: Inherited from Kinematic; the speed is bounded by the flight envelope.
